summary: Frontend-only verification of the new GitHub Push feature end-to-end. All 6 acceptance criteria in the review request passed on the deployed preview URL. Auth bootstrap done by POST /api/auth/register (qa_<ts>@example.com / Test1234!) and injecting the returned JWT into localStorage.promethius_token, then navigating to /chat. Verified: (1) data-testid='github-push-button' is present in the chat input toolbar and opens the dialog (github-push-overlay + github-push-dialog visible). (2) In not-connected state, github-token-input + github-connect-button are visible; entering the provided PAT and clicking Connect validates it — dialog subheader flips to '@rocosfsintec-del' and github-repo-trigger renders. (3) github-repo-trigger opens a list containing data-testid='github-repo-option-Promethius'; clicking it sets github-branch-input to 'main' automatically. (4) github-add-blank creates a new file row where github-file-path-0 and github-file-content-0 accept input; github-add-self opens a source-file list (frontend/src/... entries visible), confirming the 'My source' path works. (5) github-review-button transitions to the review step; the review summary correctly lists the file PROMETHIUS_UITEST.md, the branch 'promethius-uitest', and the commit message. Only github-approve-push performs the commit — the compose step's Review button does NOT push, confirming the approval gate. (6) Clicking github-approve-push produced a real commit and the success screen shows github-commit-link pointing at https://github.com/rocosfsintec-del/Promethius/commit/178440c2d853332bba6a2062a9726ee352d85ec4 — verified href contains github.com and '/commit/'. Safety honored: 'Create as new branch' (github-create-branch) was checked and branch was changed to 'promethius-uitest' before push, so main was NOT touched.
critical_code_review_comments: GithubPush.jsx addSelfFile() replaces any existing file at the same path (filter+push). Good de-duplication behavior — no action needed.

GithubPush.jsx canReview requires files.every(f => f.path.trim()) but does NOT require content to be non-empty. Empty-content commits are allowed by GitHub API (writes an empty file); this is intentional but worth flagging if the product wants to disallow empty files.

ChatPanel.jsx passes lastAssistantMessage as the reversed-find of the latest assistant text message. Extraction regex in extractCodeBlocks only matches fenced blocks with a trailing newline after the lang hint (```lang\n...```); a leading-space or CRLF variant would be missed. Non-blocking — from-chat wasn't in the required acceptance list.

Dialog is dismissed by clicking the overlay (onClick={onClose} on the outer div). Because the inner card calls e.stopPropagation, this is safe, but there is no confirm-on-outside-click when files/message have been entered — a user could accidentally lose composition by clicking outside. Non-blocking UX suggestion.

Token is sent to /api/github/token in the request body; the not-connected UI correctly hides the token input after connect and never re-displays it. Good — matches the 'encrypted at rest, never shown again' claim.
